document.abstract: This report of the Progress Commitee covers the period June, 1938, to April, 1939. The advances in the cinematographic art are classified as follows: (I) Cinematography: (A) Professional, (B) Substandard; (II) Sound Recording; (III) Sound Reproducing Equipment; (IV) Television at the Close of 1933; (V) Publications and New Books; (VI) Appendix A: The Motion Picture Industry in Japan.
